_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 23-26 September 2025: the former and latter rain, persecution, the second virus announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He says what was meant as confusion lines up with the end time assignment as they line up and do this, calling it a major deal.
mentions.quote: it lines up with the end time assignment
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an interpretation of events already in view.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are called to pray and the power of prayer changes things, and reads that day news as an answer to prayer over what he told them to pray about.
mentions.quote: I see this as an answer to prayer today
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a news outcome read as answered prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Spirit saying this is the former and the latter rain together and another wave of glory is coming on the nations of the earth, and then saw the rain begin.
mentions.quote: This is the former and the latter rain together
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide revival identifiable as the wave described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The phrase is from Joel 2 and carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was allowed to see that pressure for persecution comes for the name, and that he saw Canada and the freedom to say what you want, including the First Amendment at home.
mentions.quote: pressure for persecution comes for his name sake
mentions.falsify_match: Legal restriction on religious speech in Canada and America.

mentions.claim_text: He names the iron curtain on North Korea, suppression from China, and Iranian Christians tortured, as the darkness trying to suppress Christianity worldwide.
mentions.quote: the iron curtain that is on North Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a description of documented current persecution.

mentions.claim_text: He describes being dragged down the street at speed and drugged to death, or losing your head for what you believe, as what great persecution and martyrdom mean.
mentions.quote: Or losing your head for what you believe. That is martyrdom
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a definition of persecution against what Western believers currently face.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when day-to-day freedoms are challenged people are called to stand and make a choice rather than be a coward.
mentions.quote: when that freedom is challenged and you are called to stand
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes they are the closers and the generation that will not taste death, but that it is not yet because the gospel must first be preached in all the world, and North Korea has not had its opportunity.
mentions.quote: North Korea has not had an opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim as given: a precondition for the return rather than a dated event, and one he uses to explain why it has not come.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a window of opportunity for the Asians and a major harvest of souls in the Asian community that will look like a tidal wave of glory hitting Asia.
mentions.quote: a major tidal wave of the glory that is about to hit Asia
mentions.falsify_match: A mass conversion movement across Asia.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a great storm coming and then a massive hand come down and scoop the bad guys up, with God defending his people in a way that will shock people.
mentions.quote: I saw a massive hand come down and scoop those bad guys up
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: divine intervention with no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He describes dead fish being bagged and cleared away as something out of the Bible, with Ontario, Canada named, and ties it to Adam lease.
mentions.quote: putting them in bags and trying to get rid of the dead fish
mentions.falsify_match: A mass fish die-off in Ontario.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The location is supplied in the room rather than by him.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a huge evergreen tree like a sequoia that he has seen before, and asks what it was about.
mentions.quote: I see an evergreen tree. I have seen this before
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an image he cannot interpret, recurring from the December 2023 sequoia word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees red, a red wave, and red all over California, repeating it.
mentions.quote: I see red all over California
mentions.falsify_match: California voting Republican statewide.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Red is not interpreted here beyond the wave image.

mentions.claim_text: He says more exposing of sex trafficking and paedophilia rings is coming, stemming from what happened in New York that day.
mentions.quote: An exposing of these pedophilia rings is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of trafficking exposures traceable to a New York case.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Trafficking prosecutions are continuous, so the base rate is high.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not just about America and there will be a revival among the youth throughout Europe.
mentions.quote: There will be a revival in the youth in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A youth revival movement across Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He describes being with young men and women having revival on their college campuses with the Spirit moving.
mentions.quote: the kids were having revival in their college campuses
mentions.falsify_match: Campus revival meetings of the kind described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Campus gatherings were already under way when this was given.

mentions.claim_text: He says something is about to happen and that he will say so long farewell, that he believes the man wanted another title, and mentions the Oklahoma City Thunder.
mentions.quote: he will say so long farewell. He was wanting another title
mentions.falsify_match: A named sportsman departing after seeking another championship.
mentions.falsify_miss: None identifiable. The man is not named and he says he does not know why he is talking about it.

mentions.claim_text: He says genetic code work was being done in Japan, China and elsewhere, and that foreign countries have no restraints where he doubts the United States would move fast.
mentions.quote: they were doing genetic code in Japan and in China
mentions.falsify_match: Human genetic engineering programmes in Japan and China outrunning American regulation.

mentions.claim_text: He says they released this, that he feels the year of it, and that the Lord said he has called and assigned them to pray for it to be delayed unless they pray.
mentions.quote: I have called you and assigned you to pray for this stuff
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the year is felt but not stated, and the outcome is made conditional on prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a leader at a familiar podium saying my fellow Americans, there is another virus.
mentions.quote: My fellow Americans, there is another virus
mentions.falsify_match: A televised presidential announcement of a new virus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None made. This is the second telling of the March 2024 dream, eighteen months on.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord has been talking to him about viruses because he has been praying about them, and that what he went through the previous week put it fresh in his mind.
mentions.quote: it put it fresh on my mind because of what we went through
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an unusually direct account of where the material came from, his own recent illness.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking is coming to America as a first wave, with the tidal wave coming into shore and a greater wave behind it as it goes back.
mentions.quote: there will be a greater wave behind it
mentions.falsify_match: Two successive crises, the second larger than the first.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The two-wave structure means any first event can be called the first wave.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not telling them to do anything but that he saw the riots in those places, and anticipates being told he is imagining it until it is in the news.
mentions.quote: But I saw the riots in the places
mentions.falsify_match: Riots in the places he has named.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The places are not listed in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says you can ask AI but it is all scripted the way it was designed to answer, comparing it to a home voice assistant.
mentions.quote: it is all scripted the way it was designed to say
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a view about AI systems.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is talking about watching the fig tree in the days ahead and saying it loudly, and to watch Israel.
mentions.quote: Watch Israel in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to watch, with nothing attached.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats watch Israel and watch what is about to happen, and says a great shaking.
mentions.quote: Watch what is fixing to happen. A great shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A major event in Israel.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically he pronounces woe on those with hidden sin, says judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, and begins a woe over Israel.
mentions.quote: Woe unto you who have hidden sin
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a pronouncement with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says Israel is under pressure on all fronts with enemies on all sides, and that he sees the hand of the Lord with them very clearly.
mentions.quote: Israel on all fronts. I see the hand of the Lord with them
mentions.falsify_match: Israel attacked on multiple fronts and prevailing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Israel had been engaged on several fronts for two years when this was said.

mentions.claim_text: He says America needs a true turnaround and an awakening, with pastors preaching true repentance, and that the cultural decline is on the pastors rather than the politicians.
mentions.quote: It is not on the politicians. It is upon the pastors
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a diagnosis with a condition attached.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for revival and awakening across Asia, Africa, South America, Europe, Canada and the Middle East.
mentions.quote: Bring revival and a great awakening
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over continents.
